title: rosa × schleicheri var. tenella
intro: Rosa × schleicheri var. tenella, commonly known as the Rosa rugosa or Japanese rose, is a fragrant, pink-flowering, ornamental shrub native to East Asia. This plant has been traditionally used in herbal medicine for its potential health benefits, which include anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant properties, helping to soothe skin irritations and wounds. The therapeutic actions of Rosa × schleicheri var. tenella include its ability to reduce inflammation and promote wound healing through its bioactive constituents, such as flavonoids, phenolic acids, and essential oils. The bioactive constituents in this plant, including rosavin, rosarin, and salidroside, have been found to contribute to its medicinal properties, providing a natural remedy for various health issues.
